name: Later
description: Later provides social media management and influencer marketing products. Its public Reporting API exposes Later Influence campaign performance, creator, platform, post, and time-series analytics for contracted instances.
agentUseSummary: Add customer-owned Later Influence Reporting API credentials, then let agents inspect bounded, identity- and content-free instance and campaign performance through three approval-gated server-side tools.

credentialRequirements.name: LATER_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Later Reporting API client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the client ID issued for the customer-owned Later Influence Reporting API contract.

credentialRequirements.name: LATER_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Later Reporting API client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay encrypts the matching client secret and uses it only in trusted server-side token exchange.

capabilities.label: Read bounded influence analytics
capabilities.description: Read Later Influence instance IDs and fixed aggregate or campaign-level engagement, impression, and reach metrics without identity, content, financial, affiliate, or conversion data.

approvalRequired.label: List Later Influence instance IDs
approvalRequired.description: List at most 25 instance IDs bound to the Reporting API client without names or cursors.

approvalRequired.label: Get aggregate Later Influence performance
approvalRequired.description: Read aggregate engagements, impressions, and reach for an exact date window of at most 31 inclusive days.

approvalRequired.label: List Later Influence campaign performance
approvalRequired.description: List at most 25 campaign IDs with engagements, impressions, and reach for one exact token-bound instance and date window of at most 31 inclusive days.

blocked.label: Read creator identity or social content
blocked.description: Creator names, handles, audience data, post text, URLs, media, campaign names, and other identity or content are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read financial or conversion analytics
blocked.description: Cost, spend, ROI, paid-media, tracking-link, affiliate, sales, and conversion metrics are outside V1.

blocked.label: Manage Later Social
blocked.description: Scheduling, publishing, media-library, Link in Bio, Inbox, social-profile, team, and account operations are outside the documented Reporting API and V1.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary Later APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, metrics, filters, sorting, cursors, pagination, raw responses, broad sync, and export are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All three reporting reads require approval; identity, content, financial/conversion analytics, social management, arbitrary APIs, pagination, and export remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same three reporting reads run directly; fixed origin and metrics, exact instance validation, redaction, first-page and date bounds, audits, and the provider's 120-request-per-minute-per-IP limit remain mandatory.

providerSetup.blocker: Later Influence access and Reporting API client credentials must be issued through the customer's Later account team. No approved customer credentials are available for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: An eligible customer must request Reporting API access, connect the issued client ID and secret, and then validate token exchange, token-bound instance scope, metric redaction, date and page bounds, rate limiting, credential replacement, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: The official Later Influence Reporting API surface: instance, campaign, platform, creator, post, time-series, paid-media, conversion, filtering, and cursor-pagination analytics.
Customer-issued clientId/clientSecret prerequisites, JSON token exchange at the fixed reporting origin, JWT bearer transport, and v2 instance and campaign-performance routes.
Trusted server-side use only, confidential credential handling, 12-hour JWT expiry, re-authentication, and credential-bound instance scope.
Required performance dates, metric parameters, cursor pagination, previous-day freshness, eventual consistency, and instance/campaign hierarchy.
Problem-detail errors, 401/403 handling, and the 120-requests-per-minute-per-IP rate limit.

securityNotes: Relay uses customer-owned Reporting API credentials only on trusted server-side infrastructure; neither credential nor the short-lived JWT is exposed to browser or agent code.

The connector returns only token-bound instance IDs and fixed engagements, impressions, and reach metrics; creator identity, campaign names, social content, financial, paid-media, affiliate, tracking, sales, and conversion data are stripped or never requested.

Requests use only https://reporting.api.later.com, reject redirects, cap responses at 1 MB, validate instance IDs, pin performance_date and fixed metrics, limit date windows to 31 inclusive days, and return only the first 25 resources without exposing cursors.

Later Social scheduling, publishing, media, Inbox, Link in Bio, social-profile and account operations; arbitrary paths, filters, sorting, metrics, pagination, raw APIs, broad sync, and export are unavailable.
The Reporting API is normally current through the previous day and eventually consistent. Relay labels that freshness and propagates the provider's 120-request-per-minute-per-IP limit.
